source: Since the original release, there’s now a notable trend of fewer unique words among newer artists.

source: Sure enough, Aesop Rock is well above every artist in the dataset, and I was obliged to add him to the chart.
claim: Aesop Rock's 7,879 unique words rank first, ahead of Busdriver's 7,324.

source: He and Aesop Rock are the only rappers with more than 7,000 unique words in their first 35,000 lyrics.
claim: Only two artists have more than 7,000 unique words: Aesop Rock (7,879) and Busdriver (7,324).
